assessment: This is an important demonstration of how α-6 nicotinic ACh receptors regulate dopamine release via GABAergic mechanisms using ex vivo voltammetry recordings coupled with pharmacological manipulations. There is solid evidence provided to show that GABA tends to suppress dopamine release in adolescents but does not affect dopamine release in adults, a finding that is novel and interesting. Together the data will be of broad interest for further understanding multi-synaptic regulation of dopamine release.
